Signed Distance Fields - by Xor - GM Shaders
Feb 19, 2025In short, SDFs are functions that describe shapes. More specifically, the distance to a shape's surface at any given point. The "Signed" part means it will return a negative distance value if the sample point is inside the shape and a positive distance if outside. That's it. Now you know what a Signed Distance Field is!
